PR surface: Source +7, Tests +21. Total +28 across 3 files.

target.title: fix(reply): deliver durable reasoning on the origin-route when /reasoning opts in
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

On the **origin-routing** delivery path, a durable `{ text, isReasoning: true }` reasoning payload for `/reasoning on` is produced, clears every dispatch-level gate, and is then **unconditionally dropped inside `routeReply`** — so opted-in durable reasoning is silently lost when a reply is routed back to its originating channel.

- `routeReply` (`src/auto-reply/reply/route-reply.ts:131`) suppresses `payload.isReasoning === true` with no opt-in flag.
- The **direct** dispatch path already honors the per-channel tri-state opt-in and delivers reasoning when enabled (`dispatch-from-config.ts:3347`/`:3537`, `reply.isReasoning === true && !reasoningPayloadsEnabled`).
- Both origin-route delivery lanes funnel through the single `routeReply` chokepoint, so the origin route never received that flag. The blanket suppression (`shouldSuppressReasoningPayload`) predates the `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` opt-in (`8d0c02c24b`), which was applied to the direct gates but not to `routeReply` — i.e. the origin route was left on the pre-opt-in "always internal" behavior. See #99492.

**Outcome:** `routeReply` gains an optional `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` param and suppresses reasoning **only when it is not enabled**, mirroring the direct-dispatch gate. `routeReplyToOriginating` threads the resolved flag. `/reasoning on` durable reasoning is delivered on the origin route; `/reasoning off` (and every caller that does not opt in) stays suppressed exactly as before.

## Evidence

The change is exercised through the **real `routeReply` function** against the real outbound-delivery seam (`deliverOutboundPayloads`) that the whole `route-reply.test.ts` suite already uses — actual code execution at the exact bug boundary, deterministic and reproducible.

- **Behavior addressed:** on the origin route, `routeReply` delivers a durable `isReasoning` payload when `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` is true, and still suppresses it when the flag is absent/false.
- **Exact command:** `pnpm exec vitest run src/auto-reply/reply/route-reply.test.ts -t "reasoning"`

**Evidence after fix — BEFORE (upstream `route-reply.ts`, new tests kept):**
```
✓ suppresses reasoning payloads by default
✓ keeps suppressing reasoning payloads when reasoning delivery is disabled
× delivers reasoning payloads when reasoning delivery is enabled
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times
Tests  1 failed | 2 passed | 38 skipped
```
→ even with `reasoningPayloadsEnabled: true`, outbound delivery is called **0 times** — the payload is dropped at `route-reply.ts:131`.

**Evidence after fix — AFTER (this PR):**
```
✓ suppresses reasoning payloads by default
✓ keeps suppressing reasoning payloads when reasoning delivery is disabled
✓ delivers reasoning payloads when reasoning delivery is enabled
Tests  3 passed | 38 skipped
```
→ `reasoningPayloadsEnabled: true` delivers the reasoning payload once; `false`/absent stays suppressed.

- **Regression + gates:** `route-reply.test.ts` + `dispatch-from-config.test.ts` — **274 passed**. `pnpm lint --threads=8` and `pnpm check:test-types` both green.
- **Proof limitation:** lead proof is the executed real-code before/after at the `routeReply` boundary. A live dev-gateway origin-routed render (Discord/Telegram, `/reasoning on`) can be staged on request.

## Exactly-once / reviewer focus

This change does not alter which payloads exist or the streamed-vs-final dedupe. It only stops `routeReply` from dropping an `isReasoning` payload it was already handed. The origin route now has the **same** delivery multiplicity as the already-correct direct path (streamed block via `dispatcher.sendBlockReply` at `:3433` + final via `sendFinalPayload` at `:3561`); it does not introduce a new duplicate the direct path lacks. Matching final payloads are filtered before final dispatch via block/direct-send evidence (`agent-runner-payloads.ts:287`/`:443`).

## Scope — intentionally out of scope

- **Queued follow-up** (`followup-runner.ts`): its re-run options set no `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` / `onReasoningStream`, so a durable reasoning payload is never emitted there — a `routeReply` flag cannot affect it. Separate, upstream concern.
- **ACP delivery** (`dispatch-acp-delivery.ts`): no reasoning plumbing exists on that path today; wiring it is separate work.
- `commands-private-route` / `commands-reset-hooks` route command acks / reset notices, never `isReasoning` — they keep the default suppress.
- No change to `shouldSuppressReasoningPayload`, provider routing, config schema, or public API.

## Linked context

- Closes #99492.
- Related #90943 (wired the blanket suppression onto the origin/follow-up path).
- Related #99401 (tri-state CLI thinking + follow-up resolver gate; its Scope note documents this exact origin-route boundary).
- Not requested by a maintainer; follow-up extending the tri-state reasoning-delivery work to the origin route.
